row.notes: Update (slot 1) of the FFB collision plugin vtable 0x145c01070 (slot 2 0x1446fbce0 reads the settings noCollisionUpper / timeToDepleteMax); the cell 0x145c01078 is its only reference. effect = [plugin+0x38], vehicle = g_Sess_VehicleTable[effect+0x128] (index < g_Sess_VehicleCount). First call with a vehicle registers the contact listener {0x1446fc5d0, plugin} through Car_Collision_AddListener and sets plugin+0x71. The listener adds the contact impulse (contact+0x38) to plugin+0x6c, clamped to [0, plugin+0x64], when the contact point speed is at least plugin+0x60 and dot(velocity, normal) / speed <= 0.0872 (0x3db27eb0, a lazily set static). Update: amplitude = plugin+0x6c * dt * gain plugin+0x50 * max(e+0x10, e+0x8) of the per-vehicle entry 0x144773160(effect-table [plugin+0x30]+0x110, vehicle index); the sign flips every call (plugin+0x70 toggles), the impulse decays by dt * plugin+0x68 * plugin+0x64 (flushed to 0 below 2^-23); out = amplitude broadcast ANDed with the lane mask plugin+0x40..+0x4c; returns out.
